title.zh: Kling 4.0把单次视频拉到30秒，10月上线
title.en: Kling 4.0把单次视频拉到30秒，10月上线

current_state.zh: Kuaishou's Kling 4.0 is previewed with native 30-second video generation, 10 keyframe controls, up to 15 multimodal reference inputs, refined video editing, stereo audio and multilingual lip-sync, with the full release and API coming in October.
current_state.en: Kuaishou's Kling 4.0 is previewed with native 30-second video generation, 10 keyframe controls, up to 15 multimodal reference inputs, refined video editing, stereo audio and multilingual lip-sync, with the full release and API coming in October.
